1: -module(join_SUITE).
    2: -moduledoc """
    3: Stage-3 (Simplex 4) integration: **trustless catch-up over loopback QUIC**. A single founder (`mode=create`,
    4: N=1) founds `join:s5a`, commits a fact, and goes quiescent. A second node (`mode=join`) then boots UNFOUNDED
    5: and, given only the founder's seed address and the out-of-band-pinned genesis hash, **catches up the whole
    6: committed log** — pulling each block+cert on the dedicated `{catchup, Ns}` channel, verifying every cert
    7: against the committee it reconstructs (never trusting the server), and replaying each verified block into its
    8: own KB as it lands. It ends caught up to the founder's height and can `prove` the founder's fact from its OWN
    9: KB, WITHOUT being a committee member (a read-only observer).
   10: 
   11: Then **S5b admission-to-voter**: the founder admits the caught-up observer (one ordinary
   12: transaction through the normal write path), the observer sees its own `peer_admitted` fact arrive over the
   13: live feed and **self-promotes to a voter** (`catchup_membership_transition` — the committed fact is the
   14: signal), and then
   15: proves it really votes: probe writes commit at `quorum(2) = 2` under EACH member's leadership, including a
   16: slot the promoted joiner leads. The admit passes the **readiness gate** (`can_join :- peer_ready(Pk)`,
   17: judged from the observer's live feed digests); a never-seen candidate is refused first.
   18: 
   19: The suite doubles as the **contact-selection regression** (the 2026-07-12 live wedge — a restarted founder
   20: whose seed head was its OWN endpoint pulled history from itself forever): the joiner's `seed_peers` put its
   21: own address FIRST (selection must self-filter the seeds against `node_addr`), and the final case starts an
   22: observer whose seed list is ENTIRELY itself, so catch-up must find its contact in the live Brahms view.
   23: 
   24: Each node is its own OS Erlang node (`peer`, stdio-controlled) with its own `quod_quic` listener and Ed25519
   25: identity, so the catch-up request/response is genuine loopback QUIC — the deployment shape.
   26: """.
   27: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
   28: -include_lib("stdlib/include/assert.hrl").
   29: -include("quod_ledger.hrl").
   30: -import(quod_ct, [eventually/2, match_ok/1, ordinary_write_ok/1]).
   31: 
   32: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1]).
   33: -export([joiner_catches_up/1, joiner_resumes_after_restart/1, joiner_promoted_to_voter/1,
   34:          runtime_join_action_catches_up/1, self_seeded_joiner_catches_up/1]).
   35: 
   36: -define(NS, <<"join:s5a">>).
   37: -define(FOUNDER_PORT,  15840).
   38: -define(JOINER_PORT,   15841).
   39: -define(OBSERVER_PORT, 15842).
   40: -define(ACTION_PORT,   15843).
   41: 
   42: %% Ordered: the joiner first catches up (height 2), then — after being STOPPED and the founder committing a
   43: %% NEW fact while it is down — a restart RESUMES catch-up from its persisted height and picks up the delta;
   44: %% then the founder ADMITS the caught-up observer and it self-promotes to a voting member (S5b). A fresh
   45: %% node next exercises that same join through the public quod:node action. Finally, an observer with a USELESS
   46: %% (self-only) seed list catches up via the Brahms view (the wedge regression).
   47: all() -> [joiner_catches_up, joiner_resumes_after_restart, joiner_promoted_to_voter,
   48:           runtime_join_action_catches_up, self_seeded_joiner_catches_up].
   49: 
   50: %%%===================================================================
   51: %%% suite setup: found N=1, commit a fact, then start a mode=join node
   52: %%%===================================================================
   53: 
   54: init_per_suite(Config) ->
   55:     {FPub, _} = FKey = quod_identity:generate(),
   56:     %% JPub sorts AFTER FPub, pinning round-robin leadership at N=2: the founder leads odd slots (incl.
   57:     %% slot 5, the unpaced post-admit write = the promotion race) and the joiner leads even slots (incl.
   58:     %% slot 6, the promoted-joiner-leads acceptance).
   59:     {JPub, _} = JKey = quod_ct:generate_key_gt(FPub),
   60:     FAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?FOUNDER_PORT},
   61:     JAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?JOINER_PORT},
   62: 
   63:     %% 1. the founder: create a self-only (N=1) committee with the REAL root ontology as genesis (it
   64:     %% carries the `peer_ready`-gated `can_join` rule the admission case gates on — the production
   65:     %% shape), then commit one fact (slot 2).
   66:     Founder = start_node(?FOUNDER_PORT, FKey, Config, founder_cfg()),
   67:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 1 end, 10000)),   %% genesis committed
   68:     ?assert(eventually(
   69:               fun() ->
   70:                       ordinary_write_ok(
   71:                         prove(Founder,
   72:                               {assertz, {capital, france, paris}}))
   73:               end, 20000)),
   74:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 2 end, 10000)),   %% the fact committed
   75: 
   76:     %% 2. the anchor: the founder's genesis block_hash, delivered to the joiner out-of-band (config), never
   77:     %% TOFU'd from the contact — this is what makes catch-up trustless.
   78:     GH = peer:call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
   79:     ?assert(is_binary(GH)),
   80: 
   81:     %% 3. the joiner: mode=join, the pinned genesis hash, and a seed list with the joiner's OWN endpoint
   82:     %% FIRST — the exact live-wedge shape (2026-07-12: the restarted founder's Consul-rendered seeds had
   83:     %% itself at the head, and the old head-of-list pick pulled history from itself forever). Contact
   84:     %% selection must self-filter the seeds against `node_addr` (the node's id is its PUBKEY, which never
   85:     %% equals a {Host, Port} seed) and catch up via the founder; this joiner runs NO Brahms overlay during
   86:     %% catch-up, so the self-filtered static seeds are the only contact pool — the fallback path under test.
   87:     %% The explicit cross-learn below is a belt-and-suspenders convenience — the founder actually learns the
   88:     %% joiner from its inbound catch-up header and the joiner learns the founder from the reply header
   89:     %% (growth_SUITE proves growth needs ZERO pre-seeding); kept here to keep this suite's timing crisp.
   90:     JExtra = #{mode => join, genesis_hash => GH, seed_peers => [JAddr, FAddr]},
   91:     Joiner = start_node(?JOINER_PORT, JKey, Config, JExtra),
   92:     ok = peer:call(Founder, quod_quic, learn, [JPub, JAddr]),
   93:     ok = peer:call(Joiner,  quod_quic, learn, [FPub, FAddr]),
   94: 
   95:     [{founder, Founder}, {joiner, Joiner}, {fkey, FKey}, {fpub, FPub}, {faddr, FAddr},
   96:      {jkey, JKey}, {jaddr, JAddr}, {jextra, JExtra} | Config].
   97: 
   98: end_per_suite(Config) ->
   99:     _ = [catch peer:stop(P) || P <- [?config(founder, Config), ?config(joiner, Config)]],
  100:     ok.
  101: 
  102: %% Start one node in its own OS node: its own identity (env), its own QUIC listener on Port, then the
  103: %% namespace with the given extra config (mode/committee/genesis_hash/seed_peers). Returns the peer handle.
  104: start_node(Port, {Pub, Seed}, Config, Extra) ->
  105:     {Peer, DataDir} = start_app_node(Port, {Pub, Seed}, Config),
  106:     KeyTerm = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
  107:     Cfg = maps:merge(#{node_id => Pub, identity => #{pubkey => Pub, key => KeyTerm}, data_dir => DataDir},
  108:                      Extra),
  109:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [?NS, Cfg]),
  110:     Peer.
  111: 
  112: start_app_node(Port, {Pub, Seed}, Config) ->
  113:     Name = list_to_atom("join_" ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
  114:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
  115:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io, args => ["-pa" | code:get_path()]}),
  116:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
  117:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
  118:     KeyTerm = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
  119:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
  120:     Set(listen_port,   Port),
  121:     Set(node_addr,     {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
  122:     Set(node_pubkey,   Pub),
  123:     Set(identity_key,  KeyTerm),
  124:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
  125:     DataDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "data_" ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
  126:     %% Configuration-free CT nodes still need the one node-wide effect journal
  127:     %% in the same private durability domain as their ledgers.
  128:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir, DataDir),
  129:     Set(foreign_log, #{cache_dir => filename:join(DataDir, "foreign-history")}),
  130:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
  131:     {Peer, DataDir}.
  132: 
  133: %%%===================================================================
  134: %%% test
  135: %%%===================================================================
  136: 
  137: %% The joiner catches up the founder's log trustlessly and reads the founder's fact from its own KB, while
  138: %% remaining a NON-member (read-only): its committee is the founder alone, and it never joins the vote.
  139: joiner_catches_up(Config) ->
  140:     Founder = ?config(founder, Config),
  141:     Joiner  = ?config(joiner, Config),
  142: 
  143:     %% it reaches the founder's height (2) purely by catch-up, and reports itself settled (not syncing).
  144:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Joiner) =:= 2 end, 30000)),
  145:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> maps:get(syncing, status(Joiner), true) =:= false end, 30000)),
  146: 
  147:     %% every cert verified: the joiner's committee is exactly the founder's (folded from the genesis it
  148:     %% anchored), and the joiner is NOT in it — a read-only observer, not a voter.
  149:     FPub = pub_of(Founder),
  150:     ?assertEqual([FPub], peer:call(Joiner, quod_simplex, committee, [?NS])),
  151:     ?assertNot(lists:member(pub_of(Joiner), peer:call(Joiner, quod_simplex, committee, [?NS]))),
  152: 
  153:     %% the replayed fact is readable from the joiner's OWN kb (proof the diff was applied, not just stored).
  154:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Joiner, {capital, france, {'X'}})) end, 15000)),
  155: 
  156:     %% a write to the non-member joiner is refused (it is not a committee member) — it cannot lead a slot.
  157:     ?assertMatch({error, not_in_charge, none},
  158:                  peer:call(Joiner, quod_simplex, append,
  159:                            [?NS, dummy_tx(pub_of(Joiner))])).
  160: 
  161: %% After the founder commits a NEW fact the joiner never saw, the WHOLE namespace restarts from disk (a
  162: %% fleet redeploy): the founder re-derives its full log (mode=create, non-empty ⇒ no re-found), and the
  163: %% joiner RESUMES catch-up from its persisted partial height — never re-appending its on-disk prefix (which
  164: %% would hit the store's contiguity check), never treating the partial log as complete — reaching the new
  165: %% height and reading the new fact. Exercises the resume-from-persisted-height path (both create + join on
  166: %% restart). The joiner is stopped BEFORE the founder's commit: a live caught-up observer now TRACKS the
  167: %% head without any overlay (its readiness digests to the committee trigger ahead-replies → verified pull),
  168: %% so the resume-delta only exists while it is down.
  169: joiner_resumes_after_restart(Config) ->
  170:     Founder = ?config(founder, Config),
  171:     Joiner  = ?config(joiner, Config),
  172: 
  173:     %% take the joiner down, then commit a second fact (height 3) it cannot have seen.
  174:     ok = peer:stop(Joiner),
  175:     ?assert(eventually(
  176:               fun() ->
  177:                       ordinary_write_ok(
  178:                         prove(Founder,
  179:                               {assertz, {population, france, 67}}))
  180:               end, 20000)),
  181:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 3 end, 10000)),
  182: 
  183:     %% restart both on their SAME data_dirs (founder first so it is serving before the joiner resumes).
  184:     Founder2 = restart_node(Founder, ?FOUNDER_PORT, ?config(fkey, Config), founder_cfg(), Config),
  185:     Joiner2  = start_node(?JOINER_PORT, ?config(jkey, Config), Config, ?config(jextra, Config)),
  186:     ok = peer:call(Founder2, quod_quic, learn, [pub_of(Joiner2), ?config(jaddr, Config)]),
  187:     ok = peer:call(Joiner2,  quod_quic, learn, [?config(fpub, Config), ?config(faddr, Config)]),
  188: 
  189:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder2) =:= 3 end, 10000)),   %% founder re-derived its full log
  190:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Joiner2) =:= 3 end, 30000)),    %% joiner RESUMED from 2 to 3
  191:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> maps:get(syncing, status(Joiner2), true) =:= false end, 30000)),
  192:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Joiner2, {population, france, {'X'}})) end, 15000)),
  193:     ?assert(match_ok(prove(Joiner2, {capital, france, {'X'}}))),   %% the pre-restart prefix survived too
  194:     {save_config, [{founder2, Founder2}, {joiner2, Joiner2}]}.     %% the promotion case runs on these
  195: 
  196: %% S5b admission-to-voter. The founder ADMITS the caught-up observer — one ordinary transaction through the
  197: %% normal write path (`admit_3` gates `can_join`, stages the `peer_admitted` assert, consensus commits it).
  198: %% The observer, following live commits over the feed, applies the block that admits ITSELF: the committed
  199: %% fact is the signal — `catchup_membership_transition` re-seats its engine over the new committee and
  200: %% `is_participant`
  201: %% flips. Then the proof that it really votes: at N=2 quorum(2)=2, so NOTHING commits unless BOTH members
  202: %% sign — two probe writes, one led by each member (round-robin), must both commit and fan out.
  203: joiner_promoted_to_voter(Config) ->
  204:     {joiner_resumes_after_restart, Saved} = ?config(saved_config, Config),
  205:     Founder = ?config(founder2, Saved),
  206:     Joiner  = ?config(joiner2, Saved),
  207:     FPub  = ?config(fpub, Config),
  208:     JPub  = pub_of(Joiner),
  209:     FAddr = ?config(faddr, Config),
  210:     JAddr = ?config(jaddr, Config),
  211: 
  212:     %% the feed needs the per-ns Brahms overlay (production wiring lives in quod_app, which CT bypasses):
  213:     %% without it the live commit never reaches the observer and the whole path under test is inert.
  214:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Founder, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
  215:                         [?NS, #{node_id => FAddr, seed_peers => [JAddr]}]),
  216:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Joiner, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
  217:                         [?NS, #{node_id => JAddr, seed_peers => [FAddr]}]),
  218: 
  219:     %% pre-admit: a caught-up read-only observer.
  220:     ?assertEqual(observer, maps:get(role, status(Joiner))),
  221: 
  222:     %% the readiness gate (root ontology: `can_join :- peer_ready(Pk)`) refuses a candidate that has
  223:     %% never digested — cold, dead, or still mid-catch-up (`follows/4` keeps it silent until it is settled).
  224:     %% A failed proof commits nothing, so slot numbering below is unaffected.
  225:     {GhostPub, _} = quod_identity:generate(),
  226:     ?assertMatch({fail, [_ | _]},
  227:                  prove(Founder, {admit, GhostPub, "127.0.0.1", 9999})),
  228: 
  229:     %% the founder admits the joiner (slot 4) — retried until the joiner's periodic digests (it has been
  230:     %% feed-following since its restart) register as fresh in the founder's liveness table.
  231:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Founder, {admit, JPub, "127.0.0.1", ?JOINER_PORT})) end,
  232:                        30000)),
  233: 
  234:     %% THE PROMOTION RACE, deliberately unpaced: the very next write goes to the founder IMMEDIATELY
  235:     %% after the admit committed — quorum is now 2 but the joiner has (very likely) not yet seen its own
  236:     %% admission over the feed, so the founder's slot-5 proposal lands on a node that drops it. Without
  237:     %% the stuck-head redrive the founder's Δ would self-complain, latch complained[5], and wedge the
  238:     %% namespace forever; with it, the founder re-broadcasts the in-flight proposal each Δ until the
  239:     %% joiner promotes and votes. The prove blocks until the commit — its {ok,_,_} IS the assertion.
  240:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, prove(Founder, {assertz, {promoted, probe, 5}})),
  241:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 5 andalso slot(Joiner) =:= 5 end, 20000)),
  242: 
  243:     %% the joiner self-promoted along the way: committee, role, and settled state all flipped.
  244:     Both = lists:sort([FPub, JPub]),
  245:     ?assertEqual(Both, lists:sort(peer:call(Joiner, quod_simplex, committee, [?NS]))),
  246:     ?assertEqual(validator, maps:get(role, status(Joiner))),
  247:     ?assertEqual(false, maps:get(syncing, status(Joiner))),
  248:     ?assertEqual(Both, lists:sort(peer:call(Founder, quod_simplex, committee, [?NS]))),
  249: 
  250:     %% and it LEADS: slot 6 is the joiner's by round-robin (JPub > FPub by construction), so this write
  251:     %% commits only if the promoted joiner proposes + leads it — the milestone's acceptance.
  252:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, prove(Joiner, {assertz, {promoted, probe, 6}})),
  253:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Founder) =:= 6 andalso slot(Joiner) =:= 6 end, 20000)),
  254: 
  255:     %% both probes readable on BOTH nodes (committed by the committee, not one side's illusion).
  256:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Joiner, {promoted, probe, {'X'}})) end, 15000)),
  257:     ?assert(match_ok(prove(Founder, {promoted, probe, {'X'}}))),
  258:     {save_config, [{founder2, Founder}, {joiner2, Joiner}]}.   %% the wedge-regression case runs on these
  259: 
  260: %% THE CONTACT-SELECTION REGRESSION (live wedge, 2026-07-12): a joiner whose static seed list is ENTIRELY
  261: %% USELESS — its only seed is ITSELF — must still catch up, because the download contact is sampled from
  262: %% the live Brahms view (self-filtered, gossip-maintained), with the seeds only a cold-start fallback.
  263: %% The old picker took `seeds[0]` unfiltered on every attempt: this node would have pulled from itself
  264: %% forever ({error,{fetch,_}} / no_log), permanently wedged mid-sync. The first attempts here DO
  265: %% fail (Brahms starts just after the namespace ⇒ no view, no usable seed ⇒ {error,no_contact}), which
  266: %% also exercises the quiet re-sample-on-retry path.
  267: self_seeded_joiner_catches_up(Config) ->
  268:     {runtime_join_action_catches_up, Saved} = ?config(saved_config, Config),
  269:     Founder = ?config(founder2, Saved),
  270:     FAddr   = ?config(faddr, Config),
  271:     OKey    = quod_identity:generate(),
  272:     OAddr   = {"127.0.0.1", ?OBSERVER_PORT},
  273:     GH      = peer:call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  274:     Target  = slot(Founder),
  275:     ?assert(Target >= 6),   %% the full N=2 history (admit + both probes) is what it must pull
  276:     Obs = start_node(?OBSERVER_PORT, OKey, Config,
  277:                      #{mode => join, genesis_hash => GH, seed_peers => [OAddr]}),   %% seeds = [SELF] only
  278:     %% the Brahms overlay is the ONLY usable contact source (production wiring lives in quod_app; CT
  279:     %% starts it explicitly): its view is seeded with the founder, so sampling must find FAddr there.
  280:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Obs, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
  281:                         [?NS, #{node_id => OAddr, seed_peers => [FAddr]}]),
  282:     try
  283:         ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Obs) >= Target end, 60000)),
  284:         ?assert(eventually(fun() -> maps:get(syncing, status(Obs), true) =:= false end, 30000)),
  285:         %% caught up THROUGH the view-sampled contact: the replayed history is in its OWN KB
  286:         ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Obs, {capital, france, {'X'}})) end, 15000))
  287:     after
  288:         catch peer:stop(Obs)
  289:     end.
  290: 
  291: %% The public node-ontology action reuses the typed quod_ontology join pipeline
  292: %% rather than a second implementation. A fresh node founds root and the node
  293: %% system ontology, invokes the
  294: %% asynchronous action, then catches up through genuine loopback QUIC.
  295: runtime_join_action_catches_up(Config) ->
  296:     {joiner_promoted_to_voter, Saved} = ?config(saved_config, Config),
  297:     Founder = ?config(founder2, Saved),
  298:     Joiner = ?config(joiner2, Saved),
  299:     GenesisHash = peer:call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  300:     Target = slot(Founder),
  301:     Key = quod_identity:generate(),
  302:     {ActionNode, DataDir} = start_app_node(?ACTION_PORT, Key, Config),
  303:     RootNs = <<"quod:root">>,
  304:     NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  305:     try
  306:         RootContent =
  307:             #{namespace => RootNs, mode => create,
  308:               genesis_file => <<"ontologies/quod_root.pl">>,
  309:               data_dir => list_to_binary(DataDir), seeds => []},
  310:         {RootNs, RootConfig} =
  311:             peer:call(ActionNode, quod_app, build_ns_config, [RootContent]),
  312:         %% Match application bootstrap: lifecycle creation derives its storage
  313:         %% from the configured root, not merely from a live Prolog process.
  314:         %% Both the root and the node ontology must stay inside this CT run.
  315:         ok = peer:call(ActionNode, application, set_env,
  316:                       [quod, namespace_desired, #{content => #{RootNs => RootConfig}}]),
  317:         {ok, _} =
  318:             peer:call(
  319:               ActionNode, quod_namespace_manager, start_content,
  320:               [RootNs, RootConfig]),
  321:         ?assert(
  322:            eventually(
  323:              fun() ->
  324:                  match_ok(
  325:                    peer:call(
  326:                      ActionNode, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  327:                      [RootNs, true]))
  328:              end, 10000)),
  329:         NodeSource = list_to_binary(
  330:                        filename:join(
  331:                          code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/quod_node.pl")),
  332:         ?assertMatch(
  333:            {ok, created, NodeNs, _},
  334:            peer:call(
  335:              ActionNode, quod_ontology, create,
  336:              [NodeNs,
  337:               [{source_file, NodeSource},
  338:                {external_predicate_modules,
  339:                 [quod_ontology_predicates]}]])),
  340:         ?assert(
  341:            eventually(
  342:              fun() ->
  343:                  match_ok(
  344:                    peer:call(
  345:                      ActionNode, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  346:                      [NodeNs, true]))
  347:              end, 10000)),
  348:         Action =
  349:             {join_ontology, ?NS, binary:encode_hex(GenesisHash),
  350:              [{seed, "127.0.0.1", ?FOUNDER_PORT}]},
  351:         ?assertMatch(
  352:            {ok, [#{}], _},
  353:            peer:call(ActionNode, quod_prolog, execute,
  354:                      [NodeNs, Action])),
  355:         ?assert(
  356:            eventually(
  357:              fun() ->
  358:                  peer:call(
  359:                    ActionNode, quod_ontology, local_state, [?NS])
  360:                      =:= {ok, ready}
  361:              end, 60000)),
  362:         ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot_on(ActionNode, ?NS) >= Target end, 10000)),
  363:         ?assert(
  364:            eventually(
  365:              fun() ->
  366:                  match_ok(
  367:                    quod_ct:peer_prove(
  368:                      ActionNode, ?NS, {capital, france, {'X'}}))
  369:              end, 15000)),
  370:         ?assertEqual(observer,
  371:                      maps:get(role,
  372:                               peer:call(ActionNode, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]))),
  373:         %% The exact desired state is already true, so the same join action is
  374:         %% idempotent and performs no second join. A different anchor remains
  375:         %% a different, unsatisfied target and fails.
  376:         ?assertMatch(
  377:            {ok, [#{}], _},
  378:            peer:call(ActionNode, quod_prolog, execute,
  379:                      [NodeNs, Action])),
  380:         <<First, Rest/binary>> = GenesisHash,
  381:         WrongAction =
  382:             {join_ontology, ?NS,
  383:              binary:encode_hex(<<(First bxor 1), Rest/binary>>),
  384:              [{seed, "127.0.0.1", ?FOUNDER_PORT}]},
  385:         ?assertMatch(
  386:            {fail, [_ | _]},
  387:            peer:call(ActionNode, quod_prolog, execute,
  388:                      [NodeNs, WrongAction])),
  389:         {save_config, [{founder2, Founder}, {joiner2, Joiner}]}
  390:     after
  391:         catch peer:stop(ActionNode)
  392:     end.
  393: 
  394: %%%===================================================================
  395: %%% helpers
  396: %%%===================================================================
  397: 
  398: %% Stop a node and start a fresh OS node reusing its data_dir (derived from the port) + identity + config —
  399: %% a crash/redeploy recovering from disk. Returns the new handle.
  400: restart_node(Old, Port, Key, Extra, Config) ->
  401:     _ = catch peer:stop(Old),
  402:     start_node(Port, Key, Config, Extra).
  403: 
  404: %% The founder's namespace config: self-only committee, the REAL root ontology as genesis (carries the
  405: %% `peer_ready`-gated `can_join` the admission case gates on). Also used on restart, where the genesis
  406: %% file is simply unused (non-empty log ⇒ no re-found).
  407: founder_cfg() ->
  408:     #{mode => create, committee => [],
  409:       genesis_file => filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/quod_root.pl")}.
  410: 
  411: status(Peer) -> peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]).
  412: slot(Peer)   -> maps:get(slot, status(Peer), -1).
  413: slot_on(Peer, Ns) ->
  414:     maps:get(slot, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns]), -1).
  415: prove(Peer, Goal) -> quod_ct:peer_prove(Peer, ?NS, Goal).
  416: pub_of(Peer) -> peer:call(Peer, application, get_env, [quod, node_pubkey, undefined]).
  417: 
  418: %% A shape-valid #transaction (tx_id, origin, diff, read_check, author, sig) — never committed: the
  419: %% non-member joiner refuses the append before any consensus step even inspects it.
  420: dummy_tx(Author) -> #transaction{tx_id = <<"probe">>, origin = {?NS, <<0:256>>}, diff = [],
  421:                                  read_check = #{}, author = Author}.
